name: Windwhisk · Gremlet #45
description:
A puff of summer wind with somewhere to be. It tugs at papers and ruffles everyone's hair.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Windwhisk in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
